by_hand./api/admin/server-config: the answer is kept as text on purpose (the audit hash, the history and the options are read from the exact text), and the typed client returns a parsed model

by_hand./api/camera/{p}/stream: an address handed to the picture player, not a request of the app (the stream is opened by the player)

by_hand./api/logout: sign-in is not migrated: best effort, never throws
by_hand./api/operator/presence: the watch relay forwards the body it was given and sets its own client header and time limit
by_hand./api/refresh: sign-in is not migrated: the refresh sits below the authenticated call

by_hand./api/robot/{p}/command: the motion command: numbering, the short limit of a stop and the conditional write stay by hand until the typed path is measured
by_hand./api/settings: the whole plant state is read as a JSON tree by the view model and the watch summary
by_hand./api/stop-all: the safety stop is never migrated: it has its own two second limit and its own result
